name: Survive Undead Rush
description:
SURVIVE UNDEAD RUSH!

FIGHT OR FLIGHT!
Outrun and annihilate relentless waves of zombies that spawn continuously. Survive as the number and variety of zombies grow with each passing moment.

FACE THE BOSS!
After enduring waves of enemies, prepare yourself for the ultimate challenge—a powerful boss zombie. Defeat it to claim victory over the map.

LEVEL UP AND GEAR UP!
Collect XP from fallen zombies to upgrade your stats, boosting Health, Speed, Damage, and Rapid Fire. Gather money to unlock new characters with unique weapons like flamethrowers, submachine guns, and shotguns.

SURVIVE AND CONQUER!
Test your skills and strategy to survive the undead onslaught. Eliminate all zombies, including the formidable boss, to emerge victorious!
